mapper.select:
WITH RECURSIVE MENU_TREE AS ( SELECT M.MENU_ID , M.MENU_NAME , M.MENU_TYPE , M.PARENT_MENU_ID , M.SORT_ORDER FROM TB_MENU M INNER JOIN TB_MENU_AUTHORITY MA ON M.MENU_ID = MA.MENU_ID WHERE MA.AUTHORITY_CODE IN
#{authority.value}
AND M.USE_YN = 'Y'
UNION
SELECT P.MENU_ID , P.MENU_NAME , P.MENU_TYPE , P.PARENT_MENU_ID , P.SORT_ORDER FROM TB_MENU P INNER JOIN MENU_TREE C ON P.MENU_ID = C.PARENT_MENU_ID WHERE P.USE_YN = 'Y' ) SELECT DISTINCT MENU_ID , MENU_NAME , MENU_TYPE , PARENT_MENU_ID , SORT_ORDER FROM MENU_TREE ORDER BY SORT_ORDER
